title: Dragonflies Catch Prey 95% of the Time. Lions Manage 25%

scenes.text: A dragonfly catches its prey almost every single time.
Dragonflies succeed in up to 95 percent of their hunts.
African lions are lucky to catch 25 percent of what they chase.
Great white sharks fail nearly half the time.
The dragonfly does it in midair, going after other flying insects.
Ninety-five percent. Beating lions and sharks.
